subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

He walked slowly **lest he should fall**.

options.text: so that he may not fall

solution:
The correct answer is '**No improvement**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**lest**" is used to express a fear or a precaution.
 
• It is followed by either **should** or the **subjunctive base form** of the verb.
 
• The original phrase "**lest he should fall**" is grammatically correct and standard.
 
• **Option 3**, "lest he fall," is also grammatically correct, but as the original sentence is correct as written, no improvement is required.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 5**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"He walked slowly lest he should fall."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "in order to not fall" is incorrect as it doesn't fit the structure of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2:** "so that he may not fall" is wordy and less precise.
 
• **Option 4:** "for fear of falling" changes the grammatical structure.
